name: Mizuho Leasing Company, Limited
summary: Mizuho Leasing Company, Limited engages in the provision of general leasing services in Japan. The company offers finance, operating, and real estate leases, installment sales, auto leases, car care systems, payment outsourcing, domestic leasing, and the purchase of notes receivable. It also provides support services for entry into international markets and cross-border financing services, as well as is involved in buying and selling pre-owned property, equipment, and power generation businesses. Additionally, the company also engages in waste treatment and recycling; loans and investments in real estate, ships, aircraft, environment and energy sectors, etc; and factoring businesses.
